Prevention: Use the proper distance between orchards of 3 meters
Weed in the winter season because the weeds act as alternative hosts for aphids
Sanitise orchards by removing crop residues after harvest
If you see lady beetles, praying mantises and other beneficial organism in the field, keep them
Monitoring: Weekly observation of orchards at morning and afternoon
Count the number of the aphids on top and bottom of leaves
While the ants are climbing up and down the plant, it shows the presence of aphids
Direct Control: If possible, complete washing of trees

Use garlic, chilli and detergent (grind 100g garlic and put in water for 48 hours, then pour in to bottles and write the date on the bottles; add 100g chilli to 1 litre boiled water for 15 minutes then pack and label; add 2 spoons garlic+1 spoon chilli+ 5g detergent in one liter water then use it)
Avoid more irrigation on your orchards
Restrictions: Always use protective clothing when spraying chemicals
During the pesticide application, protect your eyes, mouth and skin
Make sure you buy the chemicals from a certified dealer
Keep pesticides out of the reach of children
Do not eat, drink and smoke during the spray
WHO Class ll - moderately hazardous, use in interval of one week spray late afternoon, use in interval of 10 days just two time
WHO list.at the interval of 7 to 10 days just two time
